Lessons.Title: Extending the Domain of Trigonometric Functions
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Interpret graphs of cosine and sine for input values less than 0. Interpret (orally and in writing) the meaning of angle measures less than 0 radians on the unit circle.
A negative radian angle rotates clockwise. Cosine is even cos(-θ)=cosθ; sine is odd sin(-θ)=-sinθ, allowing extension beyond the interval [0,2π].
